title: AMD Zen 6 Ryzen "Olympic Ridge" desktop CPUs expected in 2027
summary: AMD is reported to have delayed its Zen 6 Ryzen desktop "Olympic Ridge" CPUs to 2027, with an announcement expected around CES 2027 and launch anticipated in the first half of the year, after prioritizing the EPYC "Venice" server launch in mid-2026.

title: NSA's CNSA 2.0 mandate takes effect for new National Security Systems acquisitions
summary: Under the NSA's CNSA 2.0 transition timeline, new acquisitions for National Security Systems must support CNSA 2.0 post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA-87, AES-256) starting January 1, 2027, unless an exception is explicitly documented.

sources.title: CNSA 2.0 Explained: PQC Requirements, Timelines, and Federal Impact

title: npm retires bypass-2FA token publishing
summary: npm plans to stop letting bypass-2FA access tokens publish packages directly around January 2027; such tokens will only be able to stage a publish that still requires a maintainer's interactive two-factor approval before the package goes live.

sources.title: npm install-time security and GAT bypass2fa deprecation

title: California's SB 53 frontier AI incident-reporting duties take effect
summary: Provisions of California's Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act (SB 53) take effect, including the Office of Emergency Services' duty to publish annual anonymized summaries of reported AI critical-safety incidents.

title: CES 2027
summary: CES 2027 runs January 6-9 at the Las Vegas Convention Center plus Venetian Expo and Resorts World overflow space, with media/press days January 3-4.

title: Amazon Bedrock retires Claude Opus 4.1
summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.1, launched August 2025, reaches its Amazon Bedrock end-of-life date on January 8, 2027.

title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday — January 2027
summary: Following Microsoft's standard second-Tuesday-of-the-month cadence, the next Patch Tuesday after December 2026 falls on January 12, 2027; Microsoft has not yet published an official 2027 schedule.

title: OpenAI retires legacy Realtime and Audio API model snapshots
summary: OpenAI removes legacy audio, realtime and transcription model families and snapshots from its API, following a developer deprecation notice sent July 20, 2026.

sources.title: Deprecation notice: upcoming model shutdowns in 2026

title: Azure Blueprints (Preview) service retires
summary: Microsoft's Azure Blueprints service retires on January 31, 2027, after a phased retirement that began July 31, 2026; blueprint definitions and assignments are removed from the portal and Microsoft recommends migrating to Azure Deployment Stacks or template specs.
